title: Question about latest changes in queue api
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

### Sonarr 4.0.13.2932:
```
{
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 10,
    "sortKey": "timeleft",
    "sortDirection": "descending",
    "totalRecords": 4,
    "records": [
        ...
        {
            ...
            "statusMessages": [
                {
                    "title": "Not a Custom Format upgrade for existing episode file(s). New: [Anime Web Tier 04 (Official Subs), Bilibili] (300) do not improve on Existing: [Anime Web Tier 03 (Official Subs)] (400)",
                    "messages": []
                }
            ],
            ...
        }
    ]
}
```

### Expected Behavior

### Sonarr 4.0.12.2823:
```
{
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 10,
    "sortKey": "timeleft",
    "sortDirection": "descending",
    "totalRecords": 4,
    "records": [
        ...
        {
            ...
            "statusMessages": [
                {
                    "title": "One or more episodes expected in this release were not imported or missing from the release",
                    "messages": []
                },
                {
                    "title": "I.May.Be.a.Guild.Receptionist.but.Ill.Solo.Any.Boss.to.Clock.Out.on.Time.S01E06.1080p.CR.WEB-DL.AAC2.0.H.264-VARYG.mkv",
                    "messages": [
                        "Not a Custom Format upgrade for existing episode file(s). New: [Anime Web Tier 04 (Official Subs), CR] (306) do not improve on Existing: [Anime Web Tier 03 (Official Subs)] (400)"
                    ]
                }
            ],
            ...
        }
    ]
}
```

### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Armbian v24.11.1
- Sonarr: Sonarr 4.0.13.2932
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: No
- Browser: Null
- Database: Sqlite
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?

Null

### Anything else?

The "statusMessages" at /api/v3/queue seems to have changed in this version. Couldn't find anything obvious on the changelog.

Arr companion app [decluttarr](https://github.com/ManiMatter/decluttarr) depends on the message field to filter and clear unwanted downloads. This change has currently halted this feature of the application.

Is this an unintentional change or will future versions maintain the newer format? Thanks.
author: HellLord77
